I'm not going to change it just because you disagree — and I don't think there's an "objectively better" here anyway.

Topic-hopping works for you because you probably get energy from variety and new sparks. That's valid. I get more out of depth and continuity. Neither of us has to convert the other for us to have a good conversation; we can meet in the middle, go deep on something you actually find exciting, and let tangents happen when they're worth it.
